notes.title: 0.4B34 What's New
notes.content:
Game content update: [olist]
Add support for Steamworks SDK 1.62.

Set the player details page to be accessible only during gameplay.

For the storage module: Merge the function of the data storage structure into the storage ID structure.

For the storage module: Add a new function to merge sequence number data structures.

For the storage module: Add a new function to erase sequence number data structures.

For the storage module: Adapt all interfaces to the changes in the sequence number data structure.

For the storage module: Officially remove the data structure used for storing data.

For the storage module: Add a new interface to add data entries to the anonymous structure in the current memory.

For the storage module: Change the string pointer in the sequence number data structure to a string.

For the storage module: Replace internal anonymous structures with pointers to the new version of the sequence number data structure.

For the storage module: Remove the parameters of the "reset instance" function.

For the storage module: Remove the "delayed item deletion" parameter from the "add item" function.

For the storage module: Add initialization of the new version of instances in the constructor.

For the storage module: Use smart pointers to manage data units.

For the storage module: Use smart pointers to manage sequence number data structures.

For the storage module: Fix existing functional issues.

For the storage module: Remove an unnecessary indirection layer in the data.

For the storage module: Avoid unnecessary copying in the "add data" interface.

For the storage module: Fully adopt range-based for loops.

For the storage module: Fix the issue where some interfaces still use old pointers as parameters.

For the storage module: Improve the process of reading local data.

For the storage module: Fix the object error in the internal data reset function.

For the storage module: Fix the issue where internal data is not reset in the local data reading interface.

For the storage module: Disable the previously used debug output section.

For the engine management module: Revise the names of private members.

For the engine management module: Replace duplicate code with the newly added "compile initial scene" function from the map data module.

For the audio module: Remove all engine enums from the sound engine.

For the audio module: Modify the "stop sound engine" interface to adapt to enum changes.

For the rendering module: Add a destructor.

For the map module: Replace hardcoded values in the movement interface with dynamic calculations.

For the map module: Cache repeated variables in advance in the collision detection interface.

For the item module: Remove the duplicate version of the "player survival status" flag.

Disable a large number of unnecessary debug messages.

For the font module: Separate the size parameter from the 3D vector in the font parameter structure.

For the font module: Modify the behavior of the singleton acquisition interface.

For the font module: Add parameter checks to the font acquisition interface.

For the font module: Add a simple usage example.
